name: mathlete
description: Mental math questions above the prompt while Claude works: skill tree, adaptive difficulty, XP, levels and achievements

delaySeconds.title: Question delay (seconds)
delaySeconds.description: Show a question only after Claude has worked this long; 0 shows it at once

sound.title: Sounds
sound.description: Play a chime on level-ups and achievements (macOS)

timeLimitSeconds.title: Time limit (seconds)
timeLimitSeconds.description: Seconds to answer a revealed question before it counts as a miss; longer for questions whose target time is long; 0 turns the limit off
